    • CHANGELOG

    xernerx

    5.1.2

    Patch Changes

    • updated dependencies

    5.1.1

    Patch Changes

    • Update XernerxCLI.create to install only the selected @xernerx/* packages, use Node's native --env-file=.env flag instead of dotenv, default ENVIRONMENT="DEVELOPMENT" for global / dev checks, and stop @xernerx/terminal's default singleton spinner during interactive CLI prompts.

    5.1.0

    Minor Changes

    • Add built-in XernerxCLI (xernerx and create-xernerx-app binaries supporting create, dev, build, and start), re-export @xernerx/hooks, and update documentation and JSDoc comments.

    5.0.2

    Patch Changes

    • Update @xernerx/commands to ^0.2.3 and remove local workspace overrides.

    5.0.1

    Patch Changes

    • e9873f3: Re-export all @xernerx/* packages (@xernerx/framework, @xernerx/commands, @xernerx/stats, @xernerx/terminal, and @xernerx/websocket) from xernerx.

    5.0.0

    Major Changes

    • Unified meta-package re-exporting @xernerx/framework, @xernerx/commands, @xernerx/stats, @xernerx/terminal, and @xernerx/websocket.
